text: Assumption: A missing key results in the end iterator — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: A missing key results in the end iterator — is this correct?
norm: a missing key results in the end iterator
assumption: A missing key results in the end iterator.
rationale: The method directly returns an iterator instead of ara::core::Result, whereby not finding an element in C++ is typically signaled by the range end iterator.

original.text: Annahme: Fehlender Schlüssel führt zum End-Iterator — trifft das zu?
original.rationale: Die Methode liefert direkt einen Iterator statt ara::core::Result zurück, wodurch das Nichtauffinden in C++ üblicherweise durch den Bereichsend-Iterator signalisiert wird.
